name: Modern Insulators Limited
summary: Modern Insulators Limited manufactures and sells porcelain insulators in India and internationally. It operates through two segments: Insulators and Terry Towels. The company offers hollow porcelain insulators that are used in current transformers, voltage transformers, capacitive voltage transformers, SF6 and non-SF6 circuit breakers, surge arresters, power transformer bushings, and wall through bushings; and solid core post insulators that are used in isolators, pantographs, bus bar supports, wave trap supports, capacitor bank supports, and transmission and distribution as line post insulators.
